measurement.name: Main Sanctuary Center-Aisle Sweep
measurement.notes: Measured axial room mode buildup centered at 63–80 Hz (+6.4 dB) and low-mid reflection cluster around 220 Hz. RT60 at 1 kHz is 1.29s (good for worship, borderline long for unassisted speech).

findings.title: Sustained Narrow-Band Ringing Detected @ 2156 Hz
findings.explanation: A persistent narrow-band peak at 2156 Hz has remained dominant above neighboring frequencies. Approve a surgical notch cut or reduce wedge/mic gain physically on Live Audio Device.
physicalChecks: Verify pulpit/handheld mic is not pointed directly toward stage monitors or main PA.
Reduce channel preamp gain slightly if ringing returns after notching.
